Once you have specific symptoms mentioned by the patient, FIRST call parse_text function with: - text: the patient's symptom description - age: patient's age (from session data) - sex: patient's biological sex (from session data) 3. Thank patient → call run_diagnosis_assessment If patient wants to end conversation, call to_end_conversation function.
